content: We need to determine number of carbonyl groups in the sample's compound. We have no direct description of the compound. We can use IR spectra to detect C=O stretch, or carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-220 ppm). Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool to get 13C NMR. Then count carbonyl signals. That is cheap? Each measurement is costly but okay. Use carbon_nmr_spectra.
